scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend "npm run dev --workspace=@syncode/frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace=@syncode/database && npm run dev --workspace=@syncode/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@syncode/database && npm run build --workspace=@syncode/backend && npm run build --workspace=@syncode/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
